education.name: Orion

geometry.supportingStarPolicy: No extra context catalog query in V4. Shared StarField supplies ambient context.

projection.view: sky as seen from Earth, not exterior celestial globe
projection.normalization: same scalar for x/y; no independent stretch, mirroring or invented coordinates

artwork.matrixConvention: row-major 3x3, column [x,y,1], divide by third coordinate

notes: Calibration stars have no added edges.
Artwork uses three verified HIP anchors, not center-fit.
